_comment: The general walking exchange with Hopeful, opened by pressing interact beside him (scripts/level/Companion.gd). Until this existed the companion could be listened to but never answered.

start.speaker: Hopeful
start.text: You have that look again. Say it, brother — what is it?
start.text_zh: 你又是那个神情了。说吧，弟兄——是什么？

text_variants.text: You have gone quiet. That is usually where it starts.
text_variants.text_zh: 你安静下来了。往往就是从这里开始的。

text_variants.text: You are walking well today. Almost too well.
text_variants.text_zh: 你今天走得很好。好得有点过头。

choices.text: Let us pray. I would rather ask than carry this alone.
choices.text_zh: 我们一起祷告吧。我不想一个人扛着。

choices.text: What would you do, if you were me?
choices.text_zh: 如果你是我，你会怎么做？

choices.text: Enough about me. How are you, Hopeful?
choices.text_zh: 别说我了。你呢，盼望？你还好吗？

prayed.speaker: Hopeful
prayed.text_zh: 你们并肩站了一会儿，没有说很多话。再抬头时，路还是那条路，但它不再压着你。

advice.speaker: Hopeful
advice.text_zh: 「我会做我上次做的事，」他说，「走错，然后被找回来。你别学这个——不过你要知道，被找回来是可以的。」

returned.speaker: Hopeful
returned.text_zh: 他愣了一下，像是很久没有人问过他了。「我也怕。」他说，「不过有人问我，我就没那么怕了。」
